entities.summary: Sangeeta N. Bhatia is an American inventor, professor, and entrepreneur who holds both medical and engineering training. She holds multiple appointments and directs substantial research programs at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) in Cambridge, Massachusetts She is reported to be the first woman physician-scientist to be elected to all five of the United States' National Academies.
